description: [MyStoq] Register a NEW Mystoq store (tenant). Returns the store id, slug and an access token. No auth needed. WRITE.

phone.description: Owner phone in Algeria (e.g. 0555123456). Required — a cash-on-delivery store cannot take an order without one.

slug.description: Desired store address, the <slug>.mystoq.com part. Optional: derived from the store name when omitted. Latin letters, digits and hyphens, 3-30 chars.

name: mystoq__create_store
